item_name: Rothco Canvas Map Case Shoulder Bag With Military Stencil
item_short_desc: Stay on the right path with Rothco’s Canvas Map Case Shoulder Bag With Military Stencil.
description: Stay on the right path with Rothco’s Canvas Map Case Shoulder Bag With Military Stencil. This map case shoulder bag is designed with a thick, and stone washed cotton canvas material with intricate stitching accenting the map carrying case’s interior and exterior. The front of this map shoulder bag features the military inspired bag’s details printed in stark, gold lettering. A spacious main pocket is secured by snap closure and features a divider to aid in the organization of your maps, electronics and other gear, while the front pocket provides even more essential storage space for your everyday gear, and features two canvas slots and ten elastic straps to store tools and pens. A hard board stiffener is sewn into the back of this army canvas shoulder bag to protect electronics from damage and important documents from unwanted bending or creasing. The sturdy shoulder strap on this crossbody map bag is removable and adjustable to your optimal fit for comfortable carry.
